notes.title: Update for 11/05 has landed!
notes.content:
Conge's Crunch Time is now up to date!

We're still on devolopment for the new chapter, chapter 6.
In this update, we deliver various quality of life changes we were developing along, before it gets too late.



 Default language for the game is now English.
For the players with their system language is not English nor Korean, now the game starts with English.
 New button, My best code has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534147/baa10f044465c9f075957a6818d3791d69ce6b35.png

You need to complete each level to use it, after this update.
The shortest code with 100% success rate will be saved, and can be called via this button.

 Added a popup to recall previous conversations held at level select screen.
 New buttons has been added to dialogue screens, Skip Dialogue and Watch Logs.
 New steam achievement has been added. Solve 5-X2 without using 'Add1' nor 'Minus1' block. Useful tip is in the achievement list!



We will deliver next Chapter 6 Update with satisfying quality, for all players.
Thank you for playing Conge's Crunch Time.

notes.title: Hotfix for September 28th!
notes.content:
We fixed an issue where intro dialogue for a newly added level was not showing.
Thank you for the bug reports!

notes.title: Sep 21st hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where you couldn't use the chapter 2-3 door because of save file compatibility issues.
All players will be able to use it right.

notes.title: September 19th, Easing Difficulty Update!
notes.content:
New update for Conge's Crunch Time has come!
This update will contain new features and levels to ease the difficulty.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534147/0b15bf8099ebccd696ee811bd243789b58d47389.png


 Level clear now requires 8 additional tests, not 10. Additional clear rate will be saved.
 New levels has been added to Chapter 2, 3, 5.
 SKIP button has been added to level screen.
 Fixed robot (Register) misbehaving at certain spots.




For the next update, Chapter 6 and new contents will be delivered for all players.
Thank you for playing Conge's Crunch Time!

notes.title: July 21st hotfix landed.
notes.content:
This hotfix has a few changes, with some important one.


 Fixed 3-8 was not unlocking properly.
 Adjusted block color of altering condition, loop blocks.
 Cursor changes when hoving over draggable point of Coding interface.



We're working on features like; Loading unsuccessful input, difficulty clamp on chapter 5, and being able to clear a level with below 10 success checks. (We will grant collectible at reaching all 10 success check.)

notes.title: July 13th Update Landed!
notes.content:
This update brings you difficulty change, visual updates, click bounds update (hope it's the last one), and few quality of life changes.


 Lowered difficulty for chapter 3. Players currently at chapter 3 might have many levels unlocked at once.
 IF, IF~ELSE, Repeat Until~ Blocks now alter colors at it's position.
 Programming area now can be expanded horizontly.
 Adjusted click boundaries for Variable and Stack.
 You can undo code deletions.
 Fixed visual dismatches in certain levels.
 Some levels now has fewer cubes.

notes.title: Hotfix for July 9th.
notes.content:
This update contains fix for major issues found.
Thank you very much to everyone playing the game.


 Fixed an issue dialogue and level layouts doesn't match.
 Fixed level 4-X1 Impossible code length challenge. (I am so sorry!)
 Fixed Stack shown as queue in certain level.
 Fixed certain dialogues shown twice.
 Added extra mark for variable in 2-0.
 Some texts are now highlighted

notes.title: Patch landed for July 6th!
notes.content:
Game has been updated once more.
Really appreciate for your feedbacks.


 Fixed an issue dialogues in level select screen did not appear.
 Level 2-4, 2-X2 layouts adjusted.
 Bounds for INPUT adjusted (AGAIN!).
 Adjusted level node positions for chapter 2.

notes.title: Update for July 3rd landed!
notes.content:
This update contains some minor difficulty changes, visual improvements, gameplay improvements, and last but not least, New achievement.


 Changed a code length challenge for some levels.
 Dialogue screen now shows who's speaking.
 Now 'Return to title' button is not shown in puzzle screen.
 INPUT's cube now fits inside the pipe properly.
 Stack's click bounds has been adjusted.
 Some dialogue effects has been changed.
 Visuals for level 4-2 has been fixed.



Thank you for everyone enjoying the game!

notes.title: Hotfix of July 1st landed.
notes.content:
Thank you very much for reporting bugs and inconviniences.
This Hotfix delivers:


 Adjusted the clickable bounds of various data structures.
 Adjusted some levels' layouts for easy selection.
 Now 1-0 tutorial will show Mouse cursor guide object.
 Now skipped hard level will not count for the skip capacity.
 INPUT's Shuffle button now has an animation.
 2-X2 level has lesser cubes incoming.
 Fixed the place image of the code block was showing the wrong color at some levels.
 Fixed the Config popup failing it's initialize sequence.
 Fixed an issue dialogue doesn't appear nor disappear in level 4-6.


Below is the known issue:

 When screen resolution initialize sequence fails, game will often open in a low resolution state. If the game is blurry when you boot it up, please re-select your gameplay resolution in the Config popup.

We will find the cause of the above and deliver the patch as quickly as possible.

notes.title: June 30 Patch landed!
notes.content:
Hello, we are developers of the .
Thank you for everyone playing right after the release.
We deliver this patch with the quickly revised parts.
Great thanks for all of the feedbacks.


 Some inaccurate/missed localization fixed.
 Adjusted the clickable bounds of the INPUT. Square bounds on the floor got larger, bounds of the pipe got reduced, matching bounds with the image.
 Fixed code challenge of level 3-5 was missing.
 New music and SFX has been added.
 New dialogue effects has been added and adjusted.
 Fixed an issue being unable to watch the game intro at certain conditions.
 Fixed certain code block tooltip was not showing.
 Visuals now correctly update when clearing a formerly skipped level.
